tr_infoPlanMidweekMeeting: Select a week to start adding assignments and editing the program parts if needed. You can also use the Autofill feature and Organized will fill in assignments based on user qualifications.
tr_infoSecondPlanMidweekMeeting: Select a week to schedule it manually, or allow Organized to auto-generate assignments with the Autofill feature, considering person’s qualifications and past assignments. You can modify them as needed.
tr_exportMidweekMeetinDesc: Choose the schedules and forms you want to export and select a template. Your template choice will be saved for next time.
tr_clearMultipleDesc: Choose the schedules you want to clear. Assignments within the selected date range will be removed, but the weeks themselves will remain.
tr_unsavedChangesDesc: Your unsaved changes will be lost.
tr_weekendScheduleSavedDesc: After creating the desired schedules, remember to publish them for the congregation.
tr_personAlreadyAssignmentMeeting: This person already has an assignment in this meeting
tr_personAssignedPreviousWeek: This person had the same assignment in the previous week
tr_selectSongDesc: The speaker has provided a list of songs for this public talk. Songs already included in the meeting schedule cannot be selected.
tr_autofillDesc: Select which schedules do you want to autofill with qualified participants.
tr_autofillCompletedDesc: Weekend assignments added to the selected weeks
tr_autofillNoMaterialDesc: This week has no meeting material yet. Import it first, then try again.
tr_newWeekAddedDesc: You can find it in the meeting weeks list
tr_publishSchedulesDesc: Select the schedules you want to publish for everybody in congregation to view them. Past schedules are accessible to everyone for 3 months after their expiration date.
tr_successfullyPublishedDesc: Now everybody in your congregation can view the schedule and prepare for the assignments
tr_infoOutgoingTalk: Brothers that will visit other congregations with a public talk
tr_successfullyImportedDesc: New materials now available on related scheduling pages
tr_EPUBImportFailedDesc: Make sure that your app language matches the language of the .epub file and try again.
tr_meetingMaterialsNotAvailable: The meeting materials for this week have not been imported to Organized yet. If they are already accessible, import them from jw.org or an .epub file.
tr_customMeetingPartDesc: Your custom meeting part. If no info is entered, it won't be displayed in the schedule.
tr_clearAllAssignmentsDesc: Are you sure you want to clear all created assignments for this meeting? You can always reassign them later.
tr_visitinSpeakerHelpText: You can add speakers manually, but we recommend adding them in advance on the Speakers catalog page
tr_speakersCatalogLocalDesc: Based on your selection, you see visiting speakers from other congregations. To assign another speaker not from the catalog, simply close this window and select him in the 'Speaker' field.
tr_speakersCatalogVisitingDesc: Based on your selection, you see the outgoing speakers of your congregatiog. To assign another local brother not from the catalog, simply close this window and select him in the speaker field.
tr_outgoingTalkSynced: This outgoing talk has been synced with the {{ congregation }} congregation schedule. Please contact their public talk coordinator for any corrections or updates.
tr_clearOutgoingTalkDesc: Are you sure you want to clear all assignments and congregation details for this outgoing talk? You can always fill out them later.
tr_outgoingTalkDeleteDesc: Are you sure you want to delete this outgoing talk schedule?
tr_linkedPartsDesc: Select a meeting part to automatically link opening and/or closing prayers to the same brother
tr_partNotIncludedForThisWeek: This part isn’t included for this week
tr_auxClassroomAssignServiceGroup: Assign field service group for auxiliary classroom
tr_auxClassroomAssignServiceGroupDesc: Allow selecting a specific field service group for student parts when scheduling each meeting. You can always select other students manually.
tr_auxClassroomQualificationsDesc: Choose in which classrooms each student assignment applies. Additional options will appear in the assignment qualifications on the person’s page.
tr_dutyPositionsDesc: Choose which duties are scheduled, how many people each needs and who can do them.
tr_dutyNoPersons: There are no persons yet. Add persons first, then choose who can do this duty.
tr_dutyDeleteDesc: The duty will no longer be scheduled. Past assignments stay in the history.
tr_dutySwapDesc: {{ duty }}: {{ person }}. Choose the position to swap with.
tr_dutySwapNone: There is no other position to swap with this week.
tr_dutyNoEligiblePeople: No one is eligible for this duty yet. Add eligible people in Duty positions.
tr_dutyNeverHadDuty: Has not had this duty yet
tr_dutyWarningDoubleBooked: Already on duty in this meeting
tr_dutyShortageTitle_one: {{ count }} position could not be filled
tr_dutyShortageTitle_other: {{ count }} positions could not be filled
tr_dutyShortageNoEligible: no one is eligible for this duty
tr_dutyShortageAllBusy: everyone available already has a duty in this meeting
tr_dutyNoPositionsDesc: Switch on or add duty positions to start scheduling.
tr_dutyHistoryDesc: Every duty assignment, kept even when a roster is regenerated or edited.
tr_dutyErrorNameRequired: Enter a name for the duty.
tr_dutyErrorLocked: This position is locked. Unlock it first.
tr_dutyErrorSlotNotFound: This position no longer exists. Refresh the page and try again.
tr_jwcPublishHint: Publishing sends this schedule to the publishers’ devices. Your changes are already saved on this device.
tr_jwcExportHint: Your changes are already saved on this device. Export a PDF to print or share the schedule.
tr_jwcReadOnly: You can view this schedule. Assignments are changed by the meeting overseers.
tr_jwcNoWeeksEditor: Import the meeting workbook and the Watchtower to start scheduling.
tr_jwcNoWeeksViewer: The schedule will appear here once the meeting materials are imported.
